_meta.purpose: The curated half of the safari atlas. BRANDS and REGIONS are ours; TRIPS and ROUTES are rebuilt from the Virtuoso tours feed by scripts/merge-virtuoso-journeys.mjs and are empty here on purpose.
_meta.brandNote: One key per house, not per country arm. The API lists andBeyond five times (Botswana, South Africa, Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda) and Abercrombie & Kent six; a traveller is choosing andBeyond, not andBeyond Botswana. A house is listed here BEFORE it has journeys on purpose: merge-virtuoso-journeys.mjs drops any tour whose company matches no key in this table (`unmatchedBrand`), so a missing entry is not a missing logo, it is a missing journey. Tauck, Giltedge and Remote Lands are seeded for that reason — the current feed is the pre-egress slice, which never crawled them.
_meta.regionNote: Anchors are the region's centre of gravity for game-viewing, not its capital: the Mara-Serengeti ecosystem rather than Nairobi, the Delta rather than Gaborone. scripts/merge-virtuoso-journeys.mjs tags each stop with the nearest anchor within 2,500km.
